text: Mohammed Shami has announced his retirement from test cricket.
He hadn't played a test for India in over three years.
and nobody was talking about it.
Think about what India has lost.
Shami had the most beautiful seam position in World Cricket.
Bolt upright.
every single bowl.
On flat pitches where other bowlers got nothing
That scene still found movement.
229 test wickets at an average under 28.
and overseas when India needed a breakthrough
The ball went to shummy.
Remember Lords 2021?
He didn't just bowl.
He batted.
56 knot out alongside Bhumra and India won.
Then came the injuries.
Ankle surgery, months out of the game.
He came back.
He took wickets.
But the test call never came.
This is the man who took seven wickets in a World Cup semi-final and 24 in that World Cup.
So here's the question.
Was Mohammed Shami's test career finished too soon?
Tell me in the comments and follow for more.
